module1.name: 7 Mandatory Accounting Ledgers
module1.desc: Automates all 7 mandatory books: Revenue (S1-HKD), Inventory (S2-HKD), Expenses (S3-HKD), Cash on Hand (S4-HKD), Bank Deposits (S5-HKD), Tax Liabilities (S6-HKD), and Payroll (S7-HKD). Audit-ready 24/7.

module2.name: Automated E-Invoice Reconciliation
module2.desc: Extracts and cross-references input and output e-invoices directly from tax authorities. Validates verification codes against ledgers, eliminating tax penalty risks.

module3.name: Omni-Channel Cashflow & POS Bridge
module3.desc: Ingests transactional feeds from retail POS terminals, banking QR codes, and corporate accounts. Automatically logs revenue without manual data entry.

about.title: About Archonic
about.missionText: Archonic builds regulatory-grade financial infrastructure and automation for emerging Asian economies. We empower millions of SMEs and household businesses through our flagship A-Sổ platform.
about.visionText: Positioning Archonic as Southeast Asia's benchmark tax infrastructure provider, establishing A-Sổ as the primary ledger bridge for compliant commerce.
about.approachText: Archonic is an AI-Native engineering organization. The A-Sổ platform is built on self-healing cloud architectures, rigorous microservice isolation, and automated validation pipelines—ensuring institutional uptime and guaranteed SLAs.
